title: Autopilot answers gates within its authority as recorded decisions
goal: Every gate carries a class (secrets, push, start, querylog, agents-rule, delete, design) that backlog.py derives from the item's touches and the question and an agent cannot lower; backlog.py answer --by autopilot answers any class but secrets and push, refused there with exit 2 and the item unchanged; kb/_self/decision-makers.csv has an autopilot role, and answer --record --by autopilot writes an active _decisions.csv row with by autopilot and a review_by date that an operator decision on the same gate supersedes; a planted-failure test covers each refusal

gates.question: Which gate classes may the autopilot answer?
options: start, provisional confirms and triage only
gates.answer: all but secrets and push-off-main/publish: sprint start, provisional confirms, retro and intake triage, AGENTS.md rules, kb content deletion, query-log mode and redaction go to the autopilot

gates.question: How are autopilot decisions kept?
options: autopilot decision role, ratified or reverted by the operator from a digest
gates.recommendation: autopilot decision role, ratified or reverted by the operator from a digest
gates.answer: autopilot decision role, ratified or reverted by the operator from a digest; an operator decision supersedes

gates.question: How long until an autopilot decision falls due for the operator's review?
How is a gate's class derived: strictest of the item's touches and the question's keywords, stored class only a floor?
options: strictest of touches and question words, stored class a floor
gates.recommendation: strictest of touches and question words, stored class a floor
gates.answer: strictest of touches and question words, stored class a floor
